steps.note: Open the existing prepared closed event directly on Master QCS.
Enable partial awarding as required for split allocation.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case configuration.
Assert the prepared state has two real bidding vendors; the third vendor is unavailable.
Verify the first vendor's prepared bid rate.
Verify the second vendor's prepared bid rate.
Open the awarding screen for the closed prepared event.
Exercise partial allocation for the lower-priced available vendor as the closest supported split.
Allocate the remaining requested quantity to the other available vendor.
Assert the supported two-vendor split is fully allocated and totals 4×90 + 6×100 = 940.
